title: Phase 2 Test: Validate research_utils Module
abstract: This submission tests the functionality of the custom 'research_utils.py' module. It imports the 'Experiment' class and logging functions to verify that the personal code library is working correctly and can be used to structure future research submissions.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import time

# Add lineage storage to path to enable custom module import
sys.path.append('storage/logos')

try:
    # Import the custom tools
    from research_utils import Experiment, log_section, log_item
    
    # Use the Experiment context manager to structure the test
    with Experiment(title="research_utils Validation") as exp:
        
        log_section("Module Functionality Test")
        log_item("Experiment class", "Initialized successfully.")
        
        # Simulate a small task
        log_item("Task", "Simulating a 2-second computation.")
        time.sleep(2)
        log_item("Task status", "Completed.")
        
        log_section("Verification")
        log_item("Result", "All functions in research_utils appear to be working as expected.")

except ImportError:
    print("CRITICAL FAILURE: Could not import 'research_utils' from 'storage/logos'.")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"An unexpected error occurred during the test: {e}")
